summary: Replace the heuristic layout with multi-start optimization: SLSQP over centers and radii (maximize the sum of radii subject to non-overlap and wall constraints), starting from random and ring-based initial layouts within the time budget, and keep the best feasible result.

Compute radii exactly with an LP (HiGHS) instead of the slow Python loop. After a 70 s multi-start phase, switch to basin hopping: perturb the best layout by jittering all circles or relocating one to three of them, re-optimise with SLSQP, and accept the result only if it improves.

I keep the SLSQP multi-start for the first ~90 s, then switch to basin hopping on the best layout. Each hop jitters all circles, relocates a few circles (biased toward the smallest), or swaps two circles, then re-optimises with SLSQP and keeps the result only if it improves.
